name: inovelli-lighting-sync
goal: Port the verified-working Office lighting fix (2e72108) to Gianluca's bedroom: retarget every automation and dashboard reference from the Inovelli switch entity to the Hue bulb group, and add the two guarded state-sync automations. Repo changes only — ZHA rebinding and Adaptive Lighting reconfiguration are .storage/UI operations handled by John.

userStories.title: Audit: verify every referenced entity exists on the live system
userStories.description: Grep the Gianluca package and its upper-floor dashboards for every light.*, binary_sensor.*, input_boolean.* and input_select.* reference, then verify each exists on the live system BEFORE any edit. The Office work found two nonexistent entities (light.office_all_lights_group, binary_sensor.office_aqara_motion) that had silently made automations no-ops for months; assume the same class of bug is present until proven otherwise. Verify read-only via: ssh -o BatchMode=yes hassio 'curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPERVISOR_TOKEN" http://supervisor/core/api/states/<entity_id>'. Never mutate host state and never write to /config/.storage.
acceptanceCriteria: A written inventory exists in plans/inovelli-lighting-sync/working-memory.md listing every entity referenced in the Gianluca package and its upper-floor dashboards, each marked EXISTS or MISSING against the live API.
Any MISSING entity is reported explicitly and corrected in the relevant task, or escalated if the correct entity is ambiguous.
light.gianluca_bedroom_lights is confirmed to be platform=group containing light.gianluca_ceiling_light_1..4, with no entity_id collision.
The absence of a Bayesian presence sensor in Gianluca's room is confirmed against the files, not assumed.

userStories.title: Retarget Gianluca automations from the switch to the bulbs
userStories.description: Replace light.gianluca_ceiling_light_switch with light.gianluca_bedroom_lights in every ACTION and CONDITION across packages/gianluca_room/lights/gianluca_lights_off.yaml (line 36), packages/gianluca_room/modes/gianlucas_room_occupied.yaml (lines 12, 31) and packages/gianluca_room/modes/gianlucas_room_not_occupied.yaml (lines 14, 38). In Smart Bulb Mode the switch entity cannot control the load, so these calls are currently no-ops. IMPORTANT judgment call: a paddle press is still a legitimate presence signal, so a TRIGGER pointing at the switch may be correct as-is — the Office kept the equivalent trigger (office_occupied.yaml:31). Evaluate each hit as trigger vs action/condition rather than blind-replacing. Turn-on calls must be bare light.turn_on with no brightness/color so Adaptive Lighting can intercept.
acceptanceCriteria: No action or condition in the Gianluca package targets light.gianluca_ceiling_light_switch for load control.
Any retained switch reference is a trigger and carries a comment explaining why it is intentional.
All three files use modern syntax: triggers:/conditions:/actions:, 'action:' not 'service:', and target: blocks rather than root-level entity_id:.
Every turn-on action is a bare light.turn_on with no brightness or color data.
Each file retains or gains a header comment block per CLAUDE.md.

userStories.title: Add the two guarded state-sync automations
userStories.description: Create packages/gianluca_room/lights/gianluca_lights_sync_switch_state.yaml (bulbs -> switch LED bar) and packages/gianluca_room/lights/gianluca_lights_sync_bulbs_from_switch.yaml (paddle -> bulbs). Read the Office originals first (packages/office/lights/office_lights_sync_switch_state.yaml and office_lights_sync_bulbs_from_switch.yaml) and port them with Gianluca's entities substituted. These are already deployed and confirmed working in production — port the pattern, do not reinvent it. Mirroring onto the switch is safe because Smart Bulb Mode decouples the switch's internal state from the load.
acceptanceCriteria: Both automations use mode: single and max_exceeded: silent.
Both carry a template condition that fires only when the two states actually differ — this guard prevents the pair from ping-ponging, and its absence is a build failure.
Automation IDs match their filenames per repo convention: gianluca_lights_sync_switch_state and gianluca_lights_sync_bulbs_from_switch.
Each file opens with a header comment explaining the Smart Bulb Mode decoupling and naming its counterpart file.
Modern HA syntax throughout.

userStories.title: Fix dashboard entity references
userStories.description: Point the room cards, tile and light popup consistently at light.gianluca_bedroom_lights across dashboards/kohbo/rooms/upper_floor/gianlucas_bedroom.yaml (lines 53, 148, 151), dashboards/kohbo/rooms/upper_floor/partials/gianlucas_bedroom_card.yaml (line 18) and dashboards/kohbo/rooms/partials/upper_floor_room_cards.yaml (line 100). Line 148 currently uses light.gianluca_bedroom_lights for light_entity while line 151 uses light.gianluca_ceiling_lights (the ZHA group) for entity_id — resolve that split in favour of the helper group, because Adaptive Lighting can expand an HA group but not a ZHA group entity.
acceptanceCriteria: No dashboard file under dashboards/ references light.gianluca_ceiling_light_switch for control.
The light popup uses the same entity for both light_entity and entity_id.
A comment records why light.gianluca_ceiling_lights (the ZHA group) is deliberately not used by the dashboard.

userStories.title: Validate and commit
userStories.description: Validate every changed file before handing off. There is no 'ha core check' available from the dev machine, so parse locally with HA's custom tags stubbed via a yaml.SafeLoader subclass registering no-op constructors for !include, !include_dir_named, !include_dir_list, !include_dir_merge_list, !include_dir_merge_named, !secret and !env_var. Then re-verify every entity_id in the final diff against the live API. Produce one commit; never push and never deploy — John does both. Never run deploy.sh --check (it destroys the gitignored secrets.yaml); never restart Home Assistant.
acceptanceCriteria: Every changed YAML file parses without error under the stubbed loader.
Every entity_id in every changed file is re-verified to EXIST on the live system, run against the final diff rather than the starting state.
git status shows only intended files changed — no stray edits to packages/office/** or unrelated packages.
A single commit is created with a descriptive message following the repo convention (see 2e72108), documenting root causes rather than just listing file changes.
Nothing is pushed and nothing is deployed.

The completion report surfaces two items rather than actioning them: (a) Gianluca's room has no 'lights on' automation, only a lights-off; (b) renaming switch.inovelli_vzm31_sn_* to switch.gianluca_ceiling_light_switch_* is available as optional polish and is John's .storage click.
